status: frozen-method-and-minimum-thresholds; no measurement result is included
scope: G1 terminal presentation measurement for the existing immediate-hit A1 path. This neither changes the authoritative protocol nor proves C-02, C-04, G0, G1, G2, or production acceptance.

sourceIdentity: FrameBaker commit when source material is used
logging: OSC writer encoded-byte and command-rate counters

sampleWindow.rule: Record a continuous run of at least 60 wall-clock seconds OR at least 600 rendered frames; always record both observed values.

a1Pair.purpose: Prevents treating two A1 instances as one template-keyed presentation instance.

requiredScenarios.injection: ordered canonical facts for two A1 instances
replay already-consumed facts; they must not emit a second presentation command
deliver an incremental fact after a gap or in reverse order; request/use baseline and do not invent a result
deliver a fact after its presentation time; fast-forward or omit only decorative work
apply an empty read-only baseline with throughSequence, then later incrementals; do not replay history

osc.interpretation: 64 KiB is the existing parser payload bound. The rate is the existing engine limit. Intentional duplicate input facts belong to the duplicate scenario, but may not create a stale or rejected emitted OSC command sequence.

timeline.interpretation: 42 ms is one 24 FPS sample. Rebase discontinuities are recorded separately and are not silently folded into continuous drift. A 250 ms maximum frame interval gives a conservative guard before the explicitly forbidden approximately-700-ms visible stall.

lifecycle.interpretation: Measure scene/runtime objects separately from intentional on-disk cache retention. A teardown failure is a hard fail; cache size is recorded, not treated as zero.

perScenario: OSC commands per rolling second max
lifecycle: counts before and after each required operation

hardFail: a required environment or sample-window record is absent
normal scenario produces stale/rejected sequence handling
injected scenarios replay an impact or infer an unreceived authority result
teardown retains scene objects or a canvas
pendingRealMeasurement: aggregate archive, decode, RGBA, texture, disk-cache, and retained-resource budgets
network transport latency and G2 real reconnect behavior

reportRule: A report must cite this contract, contain actual measured values and evidence paths, and state pass/fail/not-measured per item. Missing, placeholder, or estimated values are not a pass.
